versions.content: BufferProperties . bufferComputation setting for a COM Based transformer The BufferProperties . bufferComputation of a COM Based transformer shall be configured in the following way: <BUFFER-COMPUTATION> <COMPU-RATIONAL-COEFFS> <COMPU-NUMERATOR> <V> {Position of last byte in ISignalGroup - Position of first byte in ISignalGroup} + 1 </V> <V> 0 </V> </COMPU-NUMERATOR> <COMPU-DENOMINATOR> <V> 1 </V> </COMPU-DENOMINATOR> </COMPU-RATIONAL-COEFFS> </BUFFER-COMPUTATION>
